description: Find a Chinese word from its characters, its pinyin (with tone marks, tone numbers or none) or a meaning in English, Spanish, Indonesian, Thai or Vietnamese. Covers the 4,999 words of HSK 1-6. Answers with the word's pinyin, meaning, HSK level and HSK 3.0 band, the meaning and stroke count of each character, an example sentence where there is one, its sound and its Talkhao page, and up to three other words when the question fits more than one.

word.description: Just the word to look up, not the whole question: characters (反馈), pinyin with tone marks, tone numbers or none (fǎnkuì, fan3kui4, fankui), or a meaning in English, Spanish, Indonesian, Thai or Vietnamese (feedback)
